resources.string: Tap the orb, give the assistant a job, and get on with your day — it works on it in the background and tells you when it is done.

Lets your assistant use your phone for you — open any app, read what is on the screen, tap, type, scroll and switch between apps — only while it is doing a task you asked for. A small bar with a Stop button shows whenever it is working. It never pays, moves money, types passwords, PINs or OTPs, sends messages, deletes anything, changes security settings, ticks declarations or solves CAPTCHAs: at those steps it stops and hands the phone back to you. When no task is running it reads nothing.
